why: In every row the picture turns 90 degrees clockwise from one box to the next. In the last row the black square goes from bottom-left to top-left, so next it goes to top-right. Option 3 has the black square at the top-right. Option 5 (bottom-right) would be a turn the wrong way.
trick: Watch one corner move round the square: clockwise means top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.
